design_concept.mode: Light mode primary with bold, deep navy dark sections for contrast and impact
forbidden_elements: dashboard/admin UI patterns on public pages
pure stock photos of people pointing at screens

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant adapted for Enterprise B2B. Authoritative headings, highly legible sterile body.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3. Never use Inter for headings.

accents.usage: Use for overlines, step numbers (e.g., '01', '02'), and technical metadata. Uppercase + tracking-[0.2em]

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use Tailwind scale generously (p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24) to create a premium, uncrowded feel.
layouts.grids: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A) for Industries (8 cards) and Solutions (6 cards). Asymmetrical tension, mixing spans (e.g., col-span-2, col-span-1).
layouts.header: Sticky transparent-to-solid transition. Initial state transparent (ensure dark text or light text matches hero bg contrast), becomes backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 (or solid deep navy) on scroll. Includes mobile drawer.
layouts.hero: Kinetic layout. No standard split screen. Masked line-by-line headline reveal. Background uses SVG/CSS abstract network/node visuals.
layouts.footer: Massive py-20, grid columns for navigation, prominent bottom CTA band, dark theme preferred for footer to ground the site.

motion.scrolling: MANDATORY: Use @studio-freight/react-lenis for premium smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.reveals: Framer Motion. Viewport entry: smooth fade-up/slide-in (y: 20 to 0, opacity: 0 to 1). Duration: 0.6s to 0.8s. Staggered children for grids.
motion.micro_interactions: Cards: Subtle lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-xl increase on hover. Buttons: Elegant width-expanding lines or smooth background fill transitions.
motion.hero_animation: Masked text reveal (overflow-hidden on text wrapper, motion.span slides up). Slow, non-distracting movement on SVG background nodes.
motion.timeline: 6-step animated horizontal/vertical process timeline. Use Framer Motion useScroll/useTransform to draw the line or fill nodes as user scrolls.
motion.constraints: Keep animations fast, subtle. No flashing, bouncing, or layout shift. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

visual_enhancers.media_strategy: Zero stock photos. Use custom Framer Motion + SVG/CSS abstract visuals (network nodes, shields, structural grids, glowing connection lines).
visual_enhancers.parallax: Subtle parallax on background SVG elements (use Framer Motion useScroll hook).
visual_enhancers.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for 'Technology That Protects. Solutions That Perform.' (or similar brand slogans). Large, outline text (text-transparent stroke-current).
visual_enhancers.numbers: Use massive, low-opacity typography for section numbers (e.g., '01', '02') in the background or side margins to create an editorial feel.

pages_and_routing.Home: Kinetic Hero, Who We Protect (8 bento cards), Our Solutions (6 bento cards), Why Cyber Security Matters, 6-Step Timeline, Final CTA band.
pages_and_routing.About: Technology That Protects, We Are, Mission/Vision/Values, Why Choose Us, Methodology.
pages_and_routing.Technology Partners: Placeholder grid layout. Do NOT use fake logos; use sleek geometric placeholder blocks or stylized text if logos not provided.
pages_and_routing.Blog: Search input, category pills (filters), pagination logic, article card layout, rich text article template.
pages_and_routing.Contact: Full consultation form (Shadcn Form) connected to FastAPI backend, with validation and success states (Sonner toast).

components.forms_and_interactive: Shadcn UI (Input, Textarea, Select, Dialog, Sheet, Accordion). Heavily customized to remove default Vercel-look. Square or lightly rounded edges.
components.cards: Custom HTML/Tailwind. 'Crystal Glass' for overlapping elements, 'Flat/Crisp' for bento grids with 1px borders.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Use text-shadow on text overlapping abstract backgrounds if contrast dips.
accessibility.motion: Wrap heavy animations in prefers-reduced-motion media queries or Framer Motion settings.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form fields, navigation items, tabs) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="contact-submit-button"`).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: DO NOT INVENT COMPANY DATA. Use generic but professional placeholder copy (e.g., 'Delivering scalable cybersecurity solutions for enterprise infrastructure') if exact text isn't provided.
Do not center-align body text or massive blocks. Use asymmetrical layouts and optical left-alignment to create tension and professionalism.
Create depth through layering, not just shadows. Use 1px borders (border-border/40) on dark sections to define grids.
You tend to output generic SaaS layouts. Break this habit by incorporating Awwwards-style typography sizing (massive headings with tight tracking, balanced by generous negative space).
Implement the 6-step 'Our Approach' timeline meticulously. It should feel like a premium guided experience, lighting up each step (Discover, Assess, Protect, Monitor, Respond, Improve) via scroll.
Use `sonner` for toast notifications (e.g., for contact form success).
No AI emojis in the UI. Keep it strictly enterprise professional.
For the transparent-to-solid header, ensure a clean transition logic (e.g., conditionally applying classes based on window scroll Y position).
